summary: snapshot.build_snapshot keeps its signature and gains optional operation, health, handoff and worker_context inputs. New top-level sections: operation {actionable, others_waiting, blocked, idle_reason, warnings, fingerprint} (from autonomy.compute_items, read-only), supervisor_health {lock_alive, last_tick_at, last_event_kind} (lock file read without acquiring, event log), handoff {latest_id, verified, created_at} (newest handoffs/*.json plus recorded handoff_verified/handoff_not_safe events), and a per-worker context_pressure {tokens, window, ratio, level} (telemetry.find_transcript/context_pressure by worker session id and worktree; UNAVAILABLE with reason when not found). New entry point python -B -m dev_supervisor.snapshot --out FILE [--repo ROOT] builds the full snapshot read-only and writes it atomically. Account usage uses telemetry.RateLimitEventProvider only if the class exists (it does not on this branch), else UNAVAILABLE. IMPLEMENTED and TESTED offline (synthetic data). OBSERVED once live against the real default state directory (counts only, see commands). NOT TESTED: RateLimitEventProvider against a real class, the desktop Orbit rendering of the new sections (lane L2), a real worker transcript (no live worker existed).
